headline: IG Metall Union Extends Strikes Across German Auto and Shipyard Sectors
summary: Germany's IG Metall union is set to expand warning strikes across major automotive plants and shipyards, escalating walkouts in collective wage bargaining amid industry restructuring.
why: IG Metall is Germany's largest industrial union; strikes impact operations at major European automakers and marine manufacturers.

impacts.name: German Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Expanded industrial walkouts threaten assembly lines and production schedules across German vehicle plants.
